newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican policies not avoiding weaker peso -- Mancera.
newsitem.headline: Mexican policies not avoiding weaker peso -- Mancera.

text.p: Mexico's central bank governor Miguel Mancera said on Wednesday's the Banco de Mexico's monetary and foreign exchange policies do not seek to avoid a weaker peso.

"It is also opportune to clarify that the current monetary and foreign exchange policies in no way are designed to avoid a depreciation of the national currency," Mancera said in a meeting with legislators. "According to the information we have available, we estimate that it is probable that the current month of October will show the lowest monthly inflation level of the year to date," he added.
